_comment: TouchLanguage's AI jobs (Phase KN shape: content/ai-jobs/jobs.json). They live here rather than in content/ai-jobs because only the iOS applet runs them and the Mac's AIJobCatalog has no platform filter yet; move them there when it does. Model ids come from harness/routing/role-models.json via cloudRole, never from Swift.

jobs.title: Tutor replies
jobs.blurb: One or two spoken sentences from the tutor, every turn of a conversation.
jobs._engines: Decision 2026-10-15: the prototype prefers the user's own OpenAI or Google key; Apple's on-device model answers when no key is usable. The app meters cloud spend and stops at its prototype ceiling.

jobs.title: Conversation feedback
jobs.blurb: The card at the end of a conversation: what went well, three things to practise, new words.
jobs._engines: Cloud only (2026-10-15): on a canned chat Apple's on-device model, even with this prompt, critiqued the tutor's own line, invented mistakes and listed names as new words, while gpt-4o-mini quoted the real mistake. Wrong corrections are worse than none; with no usable key the card says feedback uses the learner's key.

jobs.title: Translate a tutor line
jobs.blurb: The translation shown when the learner taps a tutor line in the transcript.
